source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape with thatched dwellings, fenced courtyards, willows, plum/bamboo-like trees, rocky banks, water surfaces, a small waterside pavilion, and distant ink-wash mountains. Calligraphy at the upper right, border, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_thatched_village_houses
motifs.description: Cluster of low thatched village houses on the left, including layered straw roofs, black post-and-beam structure, window openings, red hanging accents, and small seated interior figures visible under the eaves.
must_preserve: parallel roof-thatch strokes and dark roof edges
thin vertical support posts
rectangular window and doorway linework
small seated figure outlines under the eaves
subtle tan roof wash and red architectural accents

motifs.name: foreground_gnarled_trees_and_rocks
motifs.description: Dense foreground grove at lower left with two gnarled trunks, dark stippled foliage masses, exposed roots, low rocks, and sloping textured ground beneath the village.
must_preserve: twisted trunk contour lines
dark dot-and-wash leaf texture
exposed root network spreading across the bank
ink pebble clusters and rough ground strokes
overlapping foliage silhouettes without adjacent roof details

motifs.name: fenced_plum_courtyard
motifs.description: Central low woven fence with flowering bare branches rising behind it, forming a courtyard divider between the buildings and central grove.
must_preserve: crisscross lattice pattern on the fence
thin angular plum-branch linework
small pink-red blossom dots
dark fence posts and pale wash at the base
open spacing between branches

motifs.name: central_willow_grove
motifs.description: Tall central grove of willows and leafy trees, including drooping willow boughs, dark trunks, and a dense rounded stippled canopy in front.
must_preserve: long arcing willow-leaf strokes
dark forked trunks and branch joints
mottled stippled foliage mass
layered overlap between willows and central leafy tree
soft pale wash around the tree bases

motifs.name: right_lattice_fence_gate
motifs.description: Right-side garden fence and small gate structure behind the trees, with a low crisscross fence, upright posts, and a tiny roofed gatehouse set along the waterside path.
must_preserve: diamond lattice fence linework
dark upright posts
small pitched gate roof geometry
pale tan roof wash
thin horizontal ground and shoreline strokes behind the fence

motifs.name: right_willow_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Large right bank motif with a leaning willow rooted in dark rocks, arcing branches sweeping over the water, and a curved embankment leading into the foreground.
must_preserve: long drooping willow fronds in black ink
gnarled exposed root and trunk contours
dark spotted rock texture
curving bank outline descending toward foreground water
dry-brush striations on the rocks and earth

motifs.name: foreground_thatched_water_pavilion
motifs.description: Small round or polygonal thatched waterside pavilion near the lower center, standing on posts in shallow water with a compact roof and tiny red detail beneath.
must_preserve: radial thatch strokes on the roof
dark roof rim and post lines
small red accent under the shelter
pale water wash around the posts
simple geometric pavilion silhouette

motifs.name: open_river_surface_and_distant_mountains
motifs.description: Open right-side water and far landscape atmosphere, combining pale river wash, sparse ripple arcs, distant shoreline strokes, and soft ink-wash mountain ridges at the upper right, excluding the calligraphy.
must_preserve: thin curved ripple lines across the water
light blue-green water wash
soft distant shoreline contours
dry-brush mountain ridges and pale hill washes
misty unpainted gaps between water, shore, and mountains

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
